label: Phase 2 repair api/serializers.py model imports, LeaveTaskSerializer, and Policy/Calendar serializers
instruction: Fix modules/leave_elm/api/serializers.py: (1) Import `serializers` from `rest_framework` and `LeaveApplication, LeaveBalance, LeaveCalendar, LeaveCategory, LeavePolicy, LeaveTask, LeaveType` from `modules.leave_elm.models` (NOT `.models`!). (2) In `LeaveTaskSerializer`, remove the broken `self.context` expression on `leave_type_name`; instead define `title = serializers.SerializerMethodField()` (with `def get_title(self, obj) -> str:`), `description = serializers.SerializerMethodField()` (with `def get_description(self, obj) -> str:`), `application_status = serializers.CharField(source='leave_application.status', read_only=True)`, `applicant_user_id = serializers.IntegerField(source='leave_application.user_id', read_only=True)`, `start_date = serializers.DateField(source='leave_application.start_date', read_only=True)`, `end_date = serializers.DateField(source='leave_application.end_date', read_only=True)`, `purpose = serializers.CharField(source='leave_application.purpose', read_only=True)`. (3) Include `LeavePolicySerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer)` with `model = LeavePolicy`, `fields = '__all__'`, and `LeaveCalendarSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer)` with `model = LeaveCalendar`, `fields = '__all__'`, `read_only_fields = ['id', 'user_id', 'created_at', 'updated_at']`. (4) Keep `LeaveApplicationSerializer`, `LeaveBalanceSerializer`, and `ActionRequestSerializer`. Return only valid Python code.
